name: Cosmo First Limited
summary: Cosmo First Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of bi-axially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films in India and Internationally. The company provides packaging films; lamination films; label films; and industrial films, such as BOPP, biaxially oriented polyethylene terephthalate, cast polypropylene, polyethylene terephthalate glycol-modified, direct thermal printable film, Sun Protection Film Privacy Film, Safety Film labels face stock film, direct thermal printable film green graphic, films, and capacitor films, as well as synthetic paper, and rigid sheets and containers to industries, including food, beverage, personal care, and pharmaceuticals.
